🔷 Proof-of-Work 
In PoW miners solve complex mathematical puzzles to validate transactions and create new blocks

The first to solve adds the next block to the blockchain and earns a block reward this how miners make profit

Bitcoin, Litecoin, Dogecoin and early Ethereum use PoW https://t.co/bkNQplbyIm

- TECHNICAL LIMITATIONS

Dogecoin’s PoW blockchain offers just 10 TPS vs Solana’s 65,000. It lacks smart contracts, limiting use to basic transfers. No scaling solutions exist, making it obsolete for modern needs.
